newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket - Waugh almost certain to miss second test.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Waugh almost certain to miss second test.

text.p: Australia all-rounder Steve Waugh said on Monday he was almost certain to miss the second test against West Indies, starting on Friday, because of injury.
Waugh suffered a groin injury while bowling during West Indies' first innings in the first test on Sunday and immediately left the field at the Gabba.
"Normally in these situations it takes about 10 days to recover. It would be a minor miracle if I am ready to play in the second test in Sydney," Waugh told reporters.
Waugh will be unable to bowl in West Indies' second innings in Brisbane and was not expected to bat unless Australia find themselves in deep trouble on the fourth day.
At start of play on Monday, Australia led West Indies by 210 runs with all their second innings wickets in hand with six sessions left to play.
